description: Glocer-RECONX postprocesses magnetosphere simulation snapshots to locate magnetic topology changes. Its outputs identify separators and magnetic nulls where reconnection may occur and support interactive visualisation. The resource is documented by NASA GSFC. The documented physical domain is Geospace; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. It consumes another model's snapshots and is not an independent prediction of the plasma state. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
